tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Read this first: what Mamo is, the five Accounts a wallet can hold (USDC, Bitcoin, Ethereum, MAMO and Stocks), every tool here — reads, transaction-building and Account opening — and the order to call them in. No arguments, no network.

tools.name: get_mamo_guide
tools.description: How Mamo works, in Markdown. Topics: `accounts` (what each Account does), `deposits`, `withdrawals`, `rewards`, `safety` (custody, pauses, risks) and `fees`. Read the relevant topic before advising anyone to move money.

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: Every Mamo Account side by side — the USDC Account, Bitcoin Account, Ethereum Account, MAMO Account and Stocks portfolio — with current APY (none for Stocks, valued by NAV) and status: `open`, `deposits_paused`, `rebalancing_paused` (Stocks) or `paused`. No arguments, no wallet. An unreadable figure

tools.name: get_user_accounts
tools.description: Everything one wallet holds across Mamo: every Account it owns with balance, lifetime earnings, unclaimed rewards, APY and status, plus USD totals — and a stocks portfolio's NAV, cash, positions and fee due. Loose tokens and approvals: `get_wallet_balances`. A wallet with none returns an empty list.

tools.name: get_user_account
tools.description: One kind of Account for one wallet, in full: balance, lifetime earnings, unclaimed rewards, APY, status, whether a newer version exists or it is the earlier MAMO Account — or, for the stocks portfolio, NAV, cash, positions against targets and fee due. Answers a LIST: a wallet can hold two of a kind.

tools.name: get_user_activity
tools.description: What a wallet has done in Mamo, newest first: deposits, withdrawals and automatic compounding, each with amount, USD value then, tx hash and time. tools.description: How a wallet's balance in one USDC Account, Bitcoin Account, Ethereum Account or MAMO Account moved over the last 1 to 60 days: a daily series plus the change in tokens, dollars and percent. For "how much have I made?". No Account of that kind returns an empty series, not an error.

tools.description: Return the UNSIGNED calls a wallet sends to deposit into a Mamo Account: a wrap first for the Ethereum Account, an exact approval where needed, then the deposit. Call `preview_deposit` first, read its warnings out to the person, then pass its `previewId` here. Re-checked live; no calls if one fails.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mamo_news, create_account · Private data: get_started, get_accounts, get_user_accounts, get_user_account, get_user_activity, get_balance_history, get_transaction_status, get_account_details, get_wallet_balances, prepare_deposit, prepare_withdraw, preview_stock_basket, prepare_sign_in, create_account, get_account_creation_status · Public sink: get_mamo_news, prepare_deposit, prepare_withdraw, prepare_claim_rewards, prepare_stock_basket, prepare_sign_in · Destructive: preview_deposit, preview_withdraw.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mamo_news, create_account · Private data: get_started, get_accounts, get_user_accounts, get_user_account, get_user_activity, get_balance_history, get_transaction_status, get_account_details, get_wallet_balances, prepare_deposit, prepare_withdraw, preview_stock_basket, prepare_sign_in, create_account, get_account_creation_status · Public sink: get_mamo_news, prepare_deposit, prepare_withdraw, prepare_claim_rewards, prepare_stock_basket, prepare_sign_in · Destructive: preview_deposit, preview_withdraw

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
